# <playbook_cite>Following entry [TBD]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure whether 'disable the rest' means disable all other alarms or only those currently enabled; I will only disable other currently-enabled alarms to avoid unnecessary writes.</uncertainty>

access_token = login_res['access_token']

# Identify wake-up alarm from previously fetched alarms
alarms_list = alarms  # from prior cell
wake_up = None
for a in alarms_list:
    if a.get('label') == 'Wake Up':
        wake_up = a
        break

print('wake_up', wake_up)

# Compute new time 40 minutes earlier
old_time = wake_up['time']  # 'HH:MM'
h, m = map(int, old_time.split(':'))
new_minutes = h*60 + m - 40
new_h = new_minutes // 60
new_m = new_minutes % 60
new_time = f"{new_h:02d}:{new_m:02d}"
print('old_time', old_time, 'new_time', new_time)

# Update wake-up alarm time only
upd1 = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=wake_up['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, time=new_time)
print('update wake_up response', upd1)

# Disable other alarms that are currently enabled
other_updates = []
for a in alarms_list:
    if a['alarm_id'] == wake_up['alarm_id']:
        continue
    if a.get('enabled') is True:
        upd = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=a['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
        other_updates.append((a['alarm_id'], upd))
        print('disabled alarm', a['alarm_id'], 'resp', upd)

print('other_updates', other_updates)

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Need to verify that the wake-up alarm time change and disabling of other alarms actually took effect.</uncertainty>

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
alarms_after = []
while True:
    res = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # res might be list or dict; handle
    items = res['success'] if isinstance(res, dict) and 'success' in res else res
    if not items:
        break
    alarms_after.extend(items)
    page_index += 1

print('total_alarms_after', len(alarms_after))
for a in sorted(alarms_after, key=lambda x: x['alarm_id']):
    print(a['alarm_id'], a['label'], a['time'], a['enabled'])
